facts.finding: Type15 scans zero-based object slots14..15 (two). Nonzero carrier invokes attach on carrier-1 with map node0; attach overrides passed duration. Busy slots are skipped, no overwrite. load_map:754..759 initializes object kind bytes1..14,15,15 (little-endian0x0f0f0e0d).

Surrender calls bankruptcy first, then human/active-human gates, then call_god_of_death_entry; selected one-based target becomes temporary current actor, place15(node0,duration7,carrier=target), then current actor restored. Do not attach this hook to arbitrary rent bankruptcy.

Death selector enumerates active ordinary seats excluding surrendering actor; <=1 other live seat returns0. Selected target returned by message callback; no payment or revival. This is not ordinary magic-house twelve-effect dispatch.
Attach accepts type15 as god, detaches previous, assigns carrier/current node; type15 duration becomes13 regardless of place duration7; ordinary types7.

Death attachment calls sell_all_tools then sell_all_the_card. Return totals are discarded; no point refund. Tool utility moves equipped ordinary vehicle/engineer into inventory, resets traffic/dice, then clears all tool kinds. Existing Web retains equipment: explicit gap.
Sell-all-tools returns equipped traffic class1/2/3 as tool5/6/12 before clearing kinds1..13; direct equipment increment is not the receive_tool stack9 gate; only kinds1..8 replenish finite pool.
Attached slot duration decrements on own incoming action, reaches0 calls detach. No day/round countdown claim.

Removal clears carrier stats/node/duration; pair creation only zero-based index<12. Both type15 slots are outside pair branch. player_bankrupt:88..100 first clears participation and removes the attached slot when nonzero, including15, before later exit processing.
Original map initialization places odd1..11 then13/14. No type15 placement here.
Month entry replaces13/14 only. No15 or periodic five-round all-god refill established.

Death selector callback: message0x205 routes to cancellation, kills timer and posts result0 (2165..2182); confirmed selected one-based seat is posted after stage5 (1815..1820), mapped from ordinary-seat table built at2469..2506. Caller skips place15 on0. Cancel does not undo prior surrender/bankruptcy. Keyboard Escape equivalence not established.
Placement uses first adjacent node to calculate facing. This initializes direction, does not schedule autonomous movement.
fcn40fafd sets transient render XY/velocity/tick counter; update_attached_object_node_idx synchronizes carried god/bomb to actor node. Distinct from selecting a new road node.
Special moving actor8 uses transient object animation then removes encountered object (clearing vehicle path). Not a wandering ordinary god.
Generic visual source/destination animation reads object direction; callers include cards and tools. It is not a turn-based random walk.
Invite temporarily hides original node, animates to actor, restores source then attaches; explicit card-triggered movement.

Explicit teleport redirects a carried object to its carrier (58..90), updates player node and synchronizes attachments (340..376); the mouse-selected object branch clears old occupancy, writes new object node/new occupancy and facing (422..491). These are input-triggered relocations, not an autonomous scheduler; exact special-object selection masks remain outside this batch.
Rendering increments temporary XY and decrements animation counter, or renders node/actor positions; shown writes are visual fields, not autonomous node selection.

autonomousWandering.finding: No independent autonomous node-walk scheduler found in audited init/calendar/render/sync/card/tool call chains; absence across entire original executable not proved

decision: Keep v46 and all prior semantics. Surrender/death dual-slot/equipment behavior is tied to deferred original exit stack; do not fabricate ordinary random acquisition or retrofit all bankruptcies. Add honest presentation and reachable circuit evidence. S3-03 not fully closed.
